lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five horizontal rows of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters are visible in a grid-like formation posterior to the gill region on the lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible intersecting the primary horizontal rows of blobs, particularly in the mid-flank region, forming anchor nodes at the points of intersection.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with higher pixel intensity on the superior edge and a shadow-induced lower intensity on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains approximately 10-12 discrete, high-luminance blobs of varying sizes distributed across its visible surface area.

other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region anterior to the gill slits exhibits a high-density cluster of micro-blobs that are significantly smaller in diameter and more numerous than those on the lateral flank.
